snippet.title: Ultimate Street Fighter: Fist of Fate - Trailer (SAGE 2025)
snippet.description:
Ultimate Street Fighter: Fist of Fate trailer for SAGE 2025

Ths fangame is a tribute a to the SF franchise that consists of being the balanced SF with the largest number of mechanics possible plus with the sprites in 32 bits as in the Capcom vs Snk.
